Why the gap? No sales commissions, no showroom overhead, no middlemen. You pay for the roof and the crew that installs it — not for the pitch.

Standard: double synthetic underlayment

Included in the $475 pilot price. Two layers of synthetic underlayment protect your deck beneath the shingles — the proven, code-compliant standard for Central Florida homes.

Upgrade: the sealed deck

Full peel-and-stick coverage across the entire deck seals every seam and nail hole. It's the strongest water barrier we offer and the upgrade most insurance-conscious homeowners choose. Priced in your written proposal, square by square.

How it works — risk removed, step by step

The journey is built to remove risk, not to rush you. Education comes first. Your address is only asked when you request your written proposal.

Step 1

Learn the real price

Start with real example pricing, broken down square by square — in public, with no form and no personal data asked up front.

Step 2

Optional: instant estimate

When you're ready, draw your roof on the map tool and get an instant price range. It's optional — plenty of homeowners talk to us first.

Step 3

The contractor reviews it

Your complete package goes to the licensed contractor who will install your roof. He has 48 hours to review it, require changes, or approve it. Silence is not approval.

Step 4

Your written proposal

You receive one exact price in writing — the same number the installer already approved. Only now do we ask for your address, to finalize measurement and scheduling.

Step 5

Simple, staged deposits

$500 at signing, one-third at material delivery / start, and the balance at completion. You never pay for work that hasn't happened.

Step 6

A local crew installs it

Your roof is installed by Restore Roofing, our licensed local contractor partner — the same people who approved your price. No handoffs, no strangers.

Questions, answered straight

Why is there no sales visit?

Because the visit was never for you — it was for the commission. We price from measurement and photos, the installing contractor reviews and approves the full package, and you get one written price. Nothing about that requires someone in your living room.

Who actually installs my roof?

Restore Roofing — a licensed local roofing contractor and our turnkey installation partner, led by Randall Bryant. The same contractor who reviews and approves your price is the one whose crews install your roof.

How do payments work?

$500 at signing, one-third at material delivery / start of work, and the balance at completion. Staged to the work, the way the contractor's own schedule runs — you never pay ahead of progress.

How long is my price good for?

Written proposals carry a 30-day validity. The instant estimate on this page is pilot pricing shown as an estimate; your proposal confirms the exact number.

My roof might just need a repair. Will you push a replacement?

No. Repairs start with the $145 diagnostic, and if a repair is the right call, that's the price you get. Replacement is recommended only when the roof's condition says so.

What areas do you serve?

The Orlando metro, extending north through The Villages. If you're nearby and unsure, ask — we'd rather tell you straight than take a job we can't serve well.

Do you handle insurance claims?

We don't market or manage insurance-claim work. If your roof involves a possible claim, we'll flag it, step out of the automated flow, and handle it manually with you — homeowners work with their own public adjuster or attorney for the claim itself.
